clinician.final_diagnosis: pubic symphysis disjunction syndrome following a dystocic delivery
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 25-year-old primigravida patient presented at day 1 postpartum with acute pubic pain and tenderness localized to the pubic symphysis. Pelvic X-ray revealed a pubic symphysis disjunction. Pelvic CT scan confirmed a 3 cm disjunction with soft tissue infiltration but no fracture or other joint involvement. The patient was managed with unloading, preventive anticoagulation, and analgesics. Follow-up after 15 days showed complete resolution of symptoms and no residual tenderness on examination.

Therapeutic management included unloading, preventive anticoagulation, and analgesics
